description: This file defines a static helper class FontDataHelper within the PdfSharp.WPFonts namespace. Its purpose is to load embedded font resources related to Segoe WP fonts for Windows Phone platform support, providing static properties to access these fonts' binary data.

classes.name: FontDataHelper
classes.description: A static helper class for loading embedded font data resources related to Segoe WP fonts.

methods.name: LoadFontData
methods.description: Loads font data from embedded resources given the resource name.

properties.description: Property returning the byte array for the Segoe WP Semilight font.

properties.name: SegoeWP
